# CSDxxxxxF3 — TI FemtoFET PICOSTAR YJM

Ultra-small N-channel and P-channel MOSFETs in the Texas Instruments
PICOSTAR YJM package (0.73 × 0.64 mm, 0.36 mm height).

## Parts

| MPN | Channel | Vds | Rds(on) @4.5 V |
|-----|---------|-----|----------------|
| CSD13380F3 | N | 12 V | 76 mΩ |
| CSD15380F3 | N | 20 V | 1460 mΩ |
| CSD23280F3 | P | 12 V | 116 mΩ |
| CSD25480F3 | P | 20 V | 159 mΩ |

## Pinout

| Pin | Function |
|-----|----------|
| 1 | Gate |
| 2 | Source |
| 3 | Drain |
